support_scoring.auxiliary_support_drift: drift_vs_full_same_subset (full model output used as pseudo-reference; NOT a true-reference error)
support_scoring.note: main support tables score against the physical reference Y_geom; the old vs-full comparison is kept only to separate support change from scoring-point change

aggregation_order: per geometry per bin -> per seed equal-weight geometry mean -> cross-seed mean/sample std (ddof=1)
unit_note: nodes/points inside one geometry are not independent replicates; geometry-level means and seed-level replication are reported separately
zero_denominator: RE null when truth L2 norm <= 1e-12 (numerical zero); denominator norm recorded; MAE/max kept
